acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Marriage between Neha Kakkar and Atul Kakkar took place on 01.07.2013. One daughter born from the said wedlock is in the care and custody of the respondent/husband. Matrimonial dispute arose, and they are residing separate.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking transfer of a case must come to the court with clean hands.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that the applicant has not come to the Court with clean hands. There is concealment of material facts, which have bearing on the decision of the transfer application.
cited_cases: Neha Kakkar vs Atul Kakkar, (2026) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A party's conduct can be considered when deciding a transfer application.
legal_principles.held: Moreover, it is submitted that the conduct of the applicant is not above board. She is having an illicit relationship with one person 'X' (name avoided to be mentioned), who was earlier an employee of the HDFC Bank, Ferozepur City.
cited_cases: Neha Kakkar vs Atul Kakkar, (2026) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: Transfer of litigation to Court of competent jurisdiction at Ludhiana.
